title: $q_x$-Bass Martingales: Optimality, Existence and Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2610.20920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce the class of $q_x$-Bass martingales, extending the notion of $q$-Bass martingales. These are martingale couplings with prescribed marginals whose transition kernels are closest to a given family of reference kernels $(q_x)_{x \in \mathbb R^d}$ in the sense of a suitable weak optimal transport problem. We show that $q_x$-Bass martingales are optimizers of this problem and establish a strong duality result. Building on this duality, we introduce an algorithm for their computation and, under compactness assumptions on the prescribed marginals, prove its convergence, thereby establishing existence. We then specialize to one-dimensional marginals and show that the algorithm reduces to a fixed-point iteration.

translated_title: $q_x$-Bass 鞅：最优性、存在性与收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们引入了 $q_x$-Bass 鞅这一类新的鞅，扩展了 $q$-Bass 鞅的概念。这类鞅是具有给定边缘分布的鞅耦合，其转移核在某种合适的弱最优传输问题的意义下最接近于给定的参考核族 $(q_x)_{x \in \mathbb R^d}$。我们证明了 $q_x$-Bass 鞅是该问题的最优解，并建立了一个强对偶结果。基于该对偶性，我们提出了一种计算 $q_x$-Bass 鞅的算法，并在给定边缘分布满足紧性假设的条件下证明了算法的收敛性，从而确立了此类鞅的存在性。随后，我们将结果特化到一维边缘分布的情形，并证明该算法在此情形下归结为一个不动点迭代。
tldr: 本文引入 $q_x$-Bass 鞅，证明其为弱最优传输问题的最优解并建立强对偶性，据此提出计算算法并在紧性假设下证明其收敛性，从而确立了此类鞅的存在性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces $q_x$-Bass martingales, proves they are optimizers of a weak optimal transport problem with a strong duality result, and develops a convergent algorithm that establishes their existence under compactness assumptions.
